rule_text.name: 701.93a
rule_text.rule: Voyage is a keyword action. “(a permanent) voyages” means “If this permanent isn't blocking or the target of a spell or ability other than this one, it phases out and becomes a voyaging permanent until it phases in.”

rule_text.name: 701.93b
rule_text.rule: A voyaging permanent “returns from voyage” when it phases in.
